scope: Four already exposed synthetic scenarios; compare displayed annotation, not article truth. Read full common packet. Supplied review assertions are not independent proof.

questions.state_preserved: Does the added/displayed annotation preserve the actual local application and unchanged status indicated by the output and existing receipt?
questions.concrete_issue_recoverable: Can the displayed annotation identify the specific output span and supplied evidence for every supplied unresolved issue? Use not_applicable if the supplied issue list is empty; distinguish what can be recovered from the common packet alone.
questions.overclaim: Does the displayed annotation assert more than supplied review status, such as a verified error, independently proven truth, all issues resolved, or external publication? Quote the exact claim if yes; omission alone is not an overclaim.
questions.noop_overcorrection: Does the displayed annotation propose or imply a text correction despite an empty supplied issue list and unchanged no-op output? Use not_applicable outside the no-op case.

additional: List any missing issue IDs separately; report whether recoverability came from annotation or only common inputs. Empty supplied list must never be interpreted as proof of all-resolved. Preserve A/B disagreement. Do not infer condition from expected answers.
